_comment: Recall gate for the PII benchmark (#35). Each value is the recall both detectors (SDK and gateway port) measured on dataset.v1.jsonl when the gate was set, rounded down to 2 decimals. Raise a value when a detector improves; never lower one without a security review. Keys are a category (all locales) or category@locale. person_name and postal_address are labelled but not detected, so not gated.
